Name: DE-Employees
Statement:
select  e.Oid as EmployeeId,
        e.Name as Employee,
        c.name as Company,
        c.Oid as CompanyId,
        u.Name as [User],
        u.Oid as UserId,
        e.ExternalId,
        e.MaxValue,
        e.Active
from    Employee e 
            left join [User] u On e.[User] = u.Oid
	        join Company c on e.Company = c.Oid
